info.title: DX NetOps Spectrum
info.description:
DX NetOps Spectrum is Broadcom's fault and availability management platform for network infrastructure, modeling devices, connections, and services for real-time monitoring, root-cause analysis, and alarm management. This spec covers the OneClick Web Services API.

Authentication: HTTP Basic Auth, using a local Spectrum user account's username and password.

servers.description: OneClick Web Services API server. This platform does not apply OpenAPI server variables/paths automatically — set the integration instance's server.base_path to "/spectrum/restful".

host.description: OneClick server hostname or IP address.

basicAuth.description: HTTP Basic authentication using a local Spectrum user account's username and password.

get.summary: Issue an action against the SpectroSERVER
get.description: Issues an action request to the SpectroSERVER, identified by an internal action code, optionally targeted at a model and passed attribute-value input pairs.

parameters.name: actionCode
parameters.description: Hex action code (e.g. 0x10093) identifying the action to perform.

parameters.name: mh
parameters.description: Model handle the action is performed against.

parameters.name: attr
parameters.description: Attribute ID for an input attribute-value pair passed to the action.

parameters.name: val
parameters.description: Value for the attribute identified by `attr`.

parameters.name: throttlesize
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return per response page.

schema.description: Response body. Spectrum returns XML by default; set the Accept header to application/json (or add format=json) to receive JSON. Exact shape depends on the resource queried.

delete.description: Clears (deletes) a single alarm identified by its alarm ID.

parameters.name: alarmId
parameters.description: Alarm ID to clear.

schema.description: Response body. Spectrum returns XML by default; set the Accept header to application/json (or add format=json) to receive JSON. Exact shape depends on the resource queried.

put.description: Updates an attribute on an alarm (for example, acknowledging it) by setting an attribute ID/value pair on the alarm identified by its alarm ID.

parameters.name: alarmId
parameters.description: Alarm ID to update.

parameters.name: attr
parameters.description: Attribute ID to set on the alarm.

parameters.name: val
parameters.description: New value for the attribute.

schema.description: Response body. Spectrum returns XML by default; set the Accept header to application/json (or add format=json) to receive JSON. Exact shape depends on the resource queried.

post.description: Returns alarm counts by severity (critical, major, minor, and so on) for the alarms matching the supplied XML filter criteria.

schema.description: XML document specifying alarm filter criteria, for example a named alarm filter (`<rs:alarm-filter name="..."/>`).
Response body. Spectrum returns XML by default; set the Accept header to application/json (or add format=json) to receive JSON. Exact shape depends on the resource queried.

get.description: Returns the alarm filters defined on the OneClick server that can be referenced by name when querying alarms.

200.description: List of available alarm filter names.

schema.description: Response body. Spectrum returns XML by default; set the Accept header to application/json (or add format=json) to receive JSON. Exact shape depends on the resource queried.

get.description: Returns alarms, optionally scoped by attribute, landscape, or a page size limit.

parameters.name: attr
parameters.description: Attribute ID to include in the returned alarm data.

parameters.name: landscape
parameters.description: Landscape handle to scope the alarm query to.

parameters.name: throttlesize
parameters.description: Maximum number of alarms to return per response page.

schema.description: Response body. Spectrum returns XML by default; set the Accept header to application/json (or add format=json) to receive JSON. Exact shape depends on the resource queried.

post.summary: Query alarms by XML search criteria
post.description: GET-tunneling endpoint for advanced alarm queries: retrieves alarms matching an XML document that specifies alarm IDs, model handles, or search criteria too complex for query parameters.

schema.description: XML document specifying the alarms to retrieve, by alarm ID, model handle list, or search criteria.
Response body. Spectrum returns XML by default; set the Accept header to application/json (or add format=json) to receive JSON. Exact shape depends on the resource queried.

get.description: Returns the models associated with the given model through the specified relation type.

parameters.name: relationType
parameters.description: Relation type name (for example, a containment or connection relation).

parameters.name: modelHandle
parameters.description: Model handle to look up associations for.

schema.description: Response body. Spectrum returns XML by default; set the Accept header to application/json (or add format=json) to receive JSON. Exact shape depends on the resource queried.

post.summary: Create an association between two models
post.description: Creates an association of the given relation type between a left and a right model.

parameters.name: relationType
parameters.description: Relation type name for the new association.

parameters.name: leftModelHandle
parameters.description: Model handle of the left-side model.

parameters.name: rightModelHandle
parameters.description: Model handle of the right-side model.

schema.description: Response body. Spectrum returns XML by default; set the Accept header to application/json (or add format=json) to receive JSON. Exact shape depends on the resource queried.

delete.summary: Delete an association between two models
delete.description: Deletes an existing association of the given relation type between a left and a right model.

parameters.name: relationType
parameters.description: Relation type name of the association to remove.

parameters.name: leftModelHandle
parameters.description: Model handle of the left-side model.

parameters.name: rightModelHandle
parameters.description: Model handle of the right-side model.

schema.description: Response body. Spectrum returns XML by default; set the Accept header to application/json (or add format=json) to receive JSON. Exact shape depends on the resource queried.

get.description: Returns the valid enumeration (name/value) pairs for an enumerated attribute type.

parameters.name: attrId
parameters.description: Hex attribute ID (for example, 0x1000a) of the enumerated attribute.

schema.description: Response body. Spectrum returns XML by default; set the Accept header to application/json (or add format=json) to receive JSON. Exact shape depends on the resource queried.

get.description: Returns the connection information (ports, links) for the given device model.

parameters.name: modelHandle
parameters.description: Model handle of the device to look up connectivity for.

schema.description: Response body. Spectrum returns XML by default; set the Accept header to application/json (or add format=json) to receive JSON. Exact shape depends on the resource queried.

get.description: Returns the devices currently modeled on the OneClick server.

schema.description: Response body. Spectrum returns XML by default; set the Accept header to application/json (or add format=json) to receive JSON. Exact shape depends on the resource queried.

post.summary: Query events by XML search criteria
post.description: Retrieves events matching an XML document that specifies event IDs, model handles, or search criteria.

schema.description: XML document specifying the events to retrieve.
Response body. Spectrum returns XML by default; set the Accept header to application/json (or add format=json) to receive JSON. Exact shape depends on the resource queried.

post.description: Creates an event on the OneClick server from an XML event document.

schema.description: XML document describing the event to create, including its event type and attribute values.
Response body. Spectrum returns XML by default; set the Accept header to application/json (or add format=json) to receive JSON. Exact shape depends on the resource queried.

post.summary: Create an event against a specific model
post.description: Creates an event on the given model within the given landscape, from an XML event document.

parameters.name: landscapeHandle
parameters.description: Landscape handle the target model belongs to.

parameters.name: modelHandle
parameters.description: Model handle to raise the event against.

schema.description: XML document describing the event to create, including its event type and attribute values.
Response body. Spectrum returns XML by default; set the Accept header to application/json (or add format=json) to receive JSON. Exact shape depends on the resource queried.

get.description: Returns the landscapes (SpectroSERVERs) known to the OneClick server.

schema.description: Response body. Spectrum returns XML by default; set the Accept header to application/json (or add format=json) to receive JSON. Exact shape depends on the resource queried.

post.description: Creates a new model (for example, a device) from an XML document specifying its model type and initial attribute values.

schema.description: XML document specifying the new model's type and attribute values.

200.description: Create result, including the new model's handle.

schema.description: Response body. Spectrum returns XML by default; set the Accept header to application/json (or add format=json) to receive JSON. Exact shape depends on the resource queried.

get.description: Returns a model's attribute values by its model handle.

parameters.name: modelHandle
parameters.description: Model handle to retrieve.

parameters.name: attr
parameters.description: Attribute ID to include in the returned model data. Repeat to request multiple attributes.

schema.description: Response body. Spectrum returns XML by default; set the Accept header to application/json (or add format=json) to receive JSON. Exact shape depends on the resource queried.

put.description: Updates one or more attribute values on the given model, supplied as attribute ID/value query parameters.

parameters.name: modelHandle
parameters.description: Model handle to update.

parameters.name: attr
parameters.description: Attribute ID to set.

parameters.name: val
parameters.description: New value for the attribute.

schema.description: Response body. Spectrum returns XML by default; set the Accept header to application/json (or add format=json) to receive JSON. Exact shape depends on the resource queried.

delete.description: Deletes the model identified by its model handle.

parameters.name: modelHandle
parameters.description: Model handle to delete.

schema.description: Response body. Spectrum returns XML by default; set the Accept header to application/json (or add format=json) to receive JSON. Exact shape depends on the resource queried.

post.summary: Bulk-update attributes across models by XML
post.description: Updates one or more attribute values across one or more models in a single call, from an XML document listing model handles and attribute values.

schema.description: XML document listing the model handles and attribute values to update.
Response body. Spectrum returns XML by default; set the Accept header to application/json (or add format=json) to receive JSON. Exact shape depends on the resource queried.

post.summary: Query all devices by XML search criteria
post.description: Retrieves all device models matching an XML search-criteria document, using the OneClick server's search infrastructure.

schema.description: XML document specifying device search criteria.
Response body. Spectrum returns XML by default; set the Accept header to application/json (or add format=json) to receive JSON. Exact shape depends on the resource queried.

post.summary: Query models by XML search criteria
post.description: Retrieves models matching an XML search-criteria document, using the OneClick server's search infrastructure.

schema.description: XML document specifying model search criteria, attribute list, and result options.
Response body. Spectrum returns XML by default; set the Accept header to application/json (or add format=json) to receive JSON. Exact shape depends on the resource queried.

put.summary: Bulk-update attributes across models by XML (models endpoint)
put.description: Updates attribute values across one or more models in a single call, from an XML document listing model handles and attribute values.

schema.description: XML document listing the model handles and attribute values to update.
Response body. Spectrum returns XML by default; set the Accept header to application/json (or add format=json) to receive JSON. Exact shape depends on the resource queried.

post.description: Creates a subscription so the OneClick server pushes notifications (for example, alarm or model updates) to a listening client.

schema.description: XML document specifying the subscription's notification type, filter, and destination.

200.description: Create result, including the new subscription ID.

schema.description: Response body. Spectrum returns XML by default; set the Accept header to application/json (or add format=json) to receive JSON. Exact shape depends on the resource queried.

get.description: Returns the details of a subscription by its subscription ID.

parameters.name: subscriptionId
parameters.description: Subscription ID to retrieve.

schema.description: Response body. Spectrum returns XML by default; set the Accept header to application/json (or add format=json) to receive JSON. Exact shape depends on the resource queried.

delete.description: Deletes a subscription by its subscription ID, stopping further pushed notifications.

parameters.name: subscriptionId
parameters.description: Subscription ID to delete.

schema.description: Response body. Spectrum returns XML by default; set the Accept header to application/json (or add format=json) to receive JSON. Exact shape depends on the resource queried.

get.description: Returns notifications queued for pull-based subscriptions (as opposed to push-based delivery).

schema.description: Response body. Spectrum returns XML by default; set the Accept header to application/json (or add format=json) to receive JSON. Exact shape depends on the resource queried.

post.description: Creates one or more SNMPv3 user profiles from an XML document, for use when modeling devices that require SNMPv3.

schema.description: XML document specifying the SNMPv3 profiles to create.
Response body. Spectrum returns XML by default; set the Accept header to application/json (or add format=json) to receive JSON. Exact shape depends on the resource queried.

post.description: Deletes one or more SNMPv3 user profiles identified in an XML document.

schema.description: XML document specifying the SNMPv3 profiles to delete.
Response body. Spectrum returns XML by default; set the Accept header to application/json (or add format=json) to receive JSON. Exact shape depends on the resource queried.
